text:
Aisha: Heads up — got a burn-rate pager for /v2/generate from monitoring. 95p token latency spiked ~3x over the last 10m. Anyone looking?
Jonah: I saw the alert too, digging into token breakdowns now.
Priya: Is this the kernel rollout from earlier? We switched the attention kernel for q4-compat models at 1801200000.
Aisha: Not sure, but the dashboard shows recent kernel dimension flips for that route.
Jonah: Profiling snippet from a hot host (rough):
```
profile: top functions by time
- transformer.attn_softmax_kernel_q4  48.2%  (+30% vs baseline)
- kv_cache_lookup                        12.4%  (+5%)
- batch_dispatch                         9.1%   (-2%)
```
Jonah: Softmax kernel time is the bulk. Could be a regression in the new q4 softmax path.
Lucas: I can repro locally with the sample prompt set — q4 kernel shows worse wall-clock for long sequences. Sharing a minimal repro in thread.
Priya: Also seeing more small batches due to a change in batching heuristics yesterday (max_wait_ms lowered from 8->2). Fewer tokens per batch means softmax overhead rises.
Aisha: So two levers: kernel perf regression + degraded batching. Which is primary?
Jonah: Looking at per-route KPIs: routes with long avg seqs + low concurrency are worst. That matches both signals.
Priya: KV cache miss rate ticked up on that route as well (~2% -> 6%) after rollout — might be cache key hashing change. More misses => longer sequences and more softmax ops.
monitoring-bot: ALERT: /v2/generate latency burn rate = 2.8, window=5m, threshold=1.5. Pager triggered.
Aisha: Ok decisions: 1) rollback kernel rollout to previous softmax on the affected pool, 2) temporarily restore max_wait_ms=8 for batching, 3) add short-term routing rule to fallback to the smaller model if tokens>1024.
Lucas: I'll open the rollback PR and attach perf diff. ETA 15m.
Jonah: I'll push a dashboard tile: per-route 95p token-latency with kernel_version and batch_size dimensions. Also add a metric for kv_cache_miss_rate by route.
Priya: Update alerting: change burn-rate evaluation to use both 5m and 30m anchors and add an anomaly signal on kernel_version flips to avoid noisy pages. Also raise paging threshold for infra oncall to 3.0 for this class while we triage.
Aisha: Sounds good. Can we add a quick instrumentation event when kernel selection occurs so we can cross-correlate page windows?
Jonah: Yep — I'll emit tag kernel_selected=<name> on token-span metrics and add a short-lived panel showing kernel flips per-minute.
monitoring-bot: NOTE: routing rule created to fallback to model-small for tokens>1024 (temporary).
Aisha: Thanks. After rollback + batching change, watch for SLO recovery for 30m. If no improvement, escalate to perf team.
Lucas: Rolling back now. logs: ``deploy-bot: rollback kernel_rollout v3 -> v2 on pool-west``
Jonah: Patch for dashboards and alert tweaks pushed to monitoring repo, PR #498.
Priya: Filed a perf postmortem ticket with initial hypothesis: kernel-softmax-regression + batching change + kv-hash drift = compounding regression. Link in ticket.
Aisha: Great. Follow-ups: add automated smoke (latency-by-token) to kernel canary runs, and include kv_cache miss rate as a gating metric for kernel rollouts.
Lucas: Agree. I'll own the canary gate changes.
Aisha: Ping me if the page re-triggers after rollback. Thanks all :thumbsup:
